card.name: Advice verbs urging healthy actions
card.fires_on: Verbs and linking words in advice about what people can do to improve health or lower risk, such as 'encourage patients to increase' or 'You can do'. It also shows up on some words right before a number or quantity.

modes.label: Advice to do something
modes.description: Verbs or small words in recommendations to patients about actions that help health or lower disease risk.
modes.example: But for right now I try to encourage patients and their family members to<< increase>> their quality of life at this point,

modes.label: Before a quantity
modes.description: Small words or symbols just before a number, such as an age or percent.
modes.example: We need almost a total shift to carbon-free energy sources by 2050 and a nearer-term reduction<< of>> 25 to 40 percent

card.writes: No clear meaning; it weakly favors words like migration and a few stray non-English tokens.
card.plain: It lights up on words in health advice telling people what they can do, and sometimes just before a number.
